requirements.name: Immutable construction
requirements.text: All numerical code, witness bytes and exact source pins must remain bound to one manifest.

requirements.name: Payload and restoration
requirements.text: All arbitrary input, old-target and dirty columns satisfy the F2 supplier contract and reverse restoration.

requirements.name: Legal actual geometry
requirements.text: Every used frame, inclusion, complement, chart and boundary must be checked as an exact subspace/operator, not by rank alone.

requirements.name: Complete physical price
requirements.text: Every recursive child, scalar primitive, move, copy, bridge, route, selector and fallback must remain accounted for.

requirements.name: Full bank address safety
requirements.text: Every literal helper occurrence is assigned once; complete banks cover all coordinates; full addresses are nonaliasing.

requirements.name: Separate lift and precision claims
requirements.text: F2 semantic equality and chosen signed-lift prefix majorants remain distinct from the unchanged source's signed decoder.

requirements.name: Complete prime coverage
requirements.text: Every physically consumed and defining-source basis has exact determinant/exclusion evidence for eligible odd q.

requirements.name: Strict directed moment gap
requirements.text: Both interval engines and the full rare fallback establish strict moment bounds and reject the adjacent grid.

requirements.name: Finite ordinary closure
requirements.text: Use three finite bootstrap levels, all outer inequalities and the full inherited-constant cutoff, with old-leaf fallback.

requirements.name: Inherited theorem boundary
requirements.text: All-size compiler, covers/charts, restored rows, routing, prime supply, recovery, complex-symbolic and analytic hypotheses stay explicit.

requirements.name: Evidence honesty
requirements.text: Describe which stages ran freshly, what unchanged evidence was reused, and which cross-platform checks remain pending.

requirements.name: Documentation provenance
requirements.text: Preserve historical artifacts, licenses and contributor credit; describe the selected construction rather than additive historical gains.
